discussion.summary: The current path already requests key/front status and self activation once. No evidenced API-use mismatch was found. Review must challenge that bounded finding before Antony chooses whether to permit a named empirical ordering design, retain the present hold, or end unresolved. The empirical option is only a proposal. Product work and all six existing causal slots remain held; cause and ownership remain unresolved.

diagrams.title: Why the current probe does not discriminate cause
diagrams.caption: Appearance, main-resignation and front/resume observations do not identify a matched intervention. Qualified failures can refute row-click or marker necessity only when absence is independently established; the broad rivals have no finite falsifier.

diagrams.title: Accepted scope for repair design
diagrams.caption: Antony accepted design of a justified single-request correction, preserving repetition, driver-wait/retry, deferral and speculative-yield exclusions. The native cause remains unresolved. Concrete design and review precede implementation or runtime, with separate complete ordinary-VM acceptance required. No candidate or guest is selected.

diagrams.title: Current path and the unresolved correction choice
diagrams.caption: Numbered arrows show the existing application call order. The dotted edge moves to the assessment, not a measured cause. The no-candidate finding is bounded and awaits review. The proposed empirical ordering design would amend the justification standard only by explicit agreement; it selects no implementation, cap or guest.
